Title: Zip Gun's Self Damage & S:CE [Q: L. Scott]

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
Is the damage from a zip gun strike applied to the bearer if the
oppossing minion choose a S:CE strike. I know the S:CE resolves first
and that the Zip Gun strike never resolves. But does the Zip Gun bearer
take the damage for _choosing_ the strike or only if the strike
resolves.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Robert Goudie <robert...@studio.disney.com> writes:
>Is the damage from a zip gun strike applied to the bearer if the
>oppossing minion choose a S:CE strike. I know the S:CE resolves first
>and that the Zip Gun strike never resolves. But does the Zip Gun bearer
>take the damage for _choosing_ the strike or only if the strike
>resolves.

The bearer of the Zip Gun only takes damage (from using the Zip Gun)
during strike resolution. S:CE cancels strike resolution, so the
bearer of the Zip Gun will not take damage.

Messages.Author: Stuart J. Pieloch
Messages.Body:
Robert Goudie <robert...@studio.disney.com> hath spake thusly:

>Is the damage from a zip gun strike applied to the bearer if the
>oppossing minion choose a S:CE strike. I know the S:CE resolves first
>and that the Zip Gun strike never resolves. But does the Zip Gun bearer
>take the damage for _choosing_ the strike or only if the strike
>resolves.

All damage effects are assigned in the resolve strikes phase, can be
prevented in the prevent damage phase and are healed with blood after
that. Since you never get to the heal damage by burning blood part,
the damage never actually effects you. Talking about in other terms
may be more confusing.

HTH
